test_load_external: test loading a py::module_local type registered in an external pybind11 cross-module
test_local_bindings: test duplicate py::module_local class bindings that work across two separate pybind11 modules
test_nonlocal_failure: test that registering a non-local type in multiple pybind11 modules raises a RuntimeError
test_stl_bind_local: test STL containers like LocalVec and LocalMap with module-local pybind11 type bindings
test_cross_module_calls: test cross-module function calls and inheritance casting between two pybind11 modules
